support.title: A little help, whenever you need it.
support.intro: Questions about reading, a passage, or administrator access? We’re here to help.

sections.title: Reading & editions
sections.body: Allexi Bible is the default reading edition. Some chapters are still being prepared. Open the edition picker in the reader to see the available editions.

sections.title: Reading & study
sections.body: Read, bookmark, highlight and keep notes without signing in. The installed iOS and Android apps have no login. Published scripture updates are available when the app connects to the service.

sections.title: Administrator access
sections.body: Approved administrators sign in through Settings in the browser web app to update chapters and verses. Public account signup is not available. If you are an administrator and need a new password, choose Forgot password on the web and follow the recovery email instructions.

sections.title: Deleting your account
sections.body: Administrators can sign in to the browser web app, open Settings and choose Delete my account. Confirm with your current password. This removes the account and synced study data, and clears that account’s study data from the browser making the request. If you cannot sign in, email support with the subject Account deletion from your account email. We may need to verify account ownership. Readers do not need an account.

sections.title: Reporting a passage or a problem
sections.body: For a passage, include the edition, book, chapter and verse. For an app problem, include your device model, app version and what happened. Please do not send passwords, recovery codes or private study notes.

privacy.title: Your reading. Your privacy.
privacy.intro: This policy describes how Allexi Bible handles information when you read, study or use administrator access on the web.

sections.title: Reading without an account
sections.body: You can read without creating an account. Your reading preferences and study annotations are kept in the app. The app does not include advertising, analytics tracking, or location or microphone collection.

sections.title: Account information
sections.body: Login is available only to approved administrators in the browser web app. Your email address and password are processed by Supabase Auth to provide sign-in and recovery. Browser sign-in sessions use browser storage. The installed iOS and Android apps do not offer login. Earlier app versions may have retained native sign-in sessions in the operating system’s secure storage; mobile study sync is no longer enabled.

sections.title: What sync shares
sections.body: For signed-in web administrators, notes, bookmarks, highlights and reading position are sent to our application service and stored in Supabase for sync. Account access controls restrict access to these study records. Editorial changes and revision history are stored to manage and publish scripture updates. Readers can receive published scripture without signing in.

sections.title: Service providers & technical information
sections.body: Supabase provides authentication and database services. Our hosting and email providers process information needed to run the service, including account recovery messages. Application logs contain request identifiers, route paths, status codes and durations. Hosting providers may also process network addresses and access logs. The application does not log passwords, access tokens or study content.

sections.title: Retention & account deletion
sections.body: Your account and synced study data are retained while your account is active. You can permanently delete them in the web app’s Settings after confirming your current password, which is used to verify the request and is not stored by our application service. Deletion also clears that account’s study data from the requesting device. Other devices may retain local copies until removed there. Published scripture and editorial revision history remain, with the deleted editor’s account link removed. Provider backups may persist under the provider’s retention arrangements; deletion does not immediately erase every backup copy.

sections.title: Your choices & questions
sections.body: Reading and studying do not require an account. Login and editorial tools are reserved for approved web administrators. For privacy questions, access or correction requests, or help deleting an account you cannot access, contact the support email below. Account-related requests may require ownership verification. Never send your password or recovery code.

sections.title: Policy updates
sections.body: We may update this policy when the app or its data practices change. The date shown here identifies the latest revision. Contact us if you have a question about a change.
